rv.q: This tender little story will bring a ray of welcome sunshine to Citadel theatergoers.
“Outside Mullingar” is a sweet little Irish valentine of a play, requiring a light touch to fully bring out its placid, low-key charm.
This is a delightful experience for a theater audience, young and old.
Outside Mullingar really gets inside its characters with sweetness and charm.

cn.t: Shanley's charming Irish romantic fable receives warm praise for its intimate portrayal of late-blooming love between stubborn neighbors. Critics laud the tight construction, authentic performances, and light touch that brings out the play's low-key charm.
